summary: BRT Apartments Corp. filed an 8-K on June 2, 2026, to disclose its agreement to acquire Ranch Lake Apartments, a 336-unit multifamily property in Bradenton, Florida. The purchase price is approximately $80 million, subject to customary adjustments, funded by $45.7 million in assumed HUD-insured mortgage (2.91% rate, maturing 2056) and about $38 million balance from refinancings, property sales, and credit facility. Closing is expected in Q4 2026 or Q1 2027, contingent on due diligence, HUD and lender approval of mortgage assumption, and other conditions. No board recommendation or advisor named. What to watch: regulatory and lender approvals; risk-arb angle includes closing timeline and financing execution.
